# Hank's Tire

Hank's Tire is a family tire and auto repair shop in Woodland Hills, California.
The shop is at 19951 Ventura Blvd, Woodland Hills, CA 91364, near the 101 Freeway.
It has been family owned and operated since 1953. Steve, the founder's son, runs it.
Services are tires, wheel alignment, brake repair, smog checks, oil changes, and scheduled maintenance.
The shop is AAA-approved and runs on solar power.
Hours are Monday to Friday 8 to 5, Saturday 8 to 3, closed Sunday.
The phone number is (818) 340-4200.
Email is hankstire@aol.com.
Drivers come from Woodland Hills, Calabasas, Encino, and the San Fernando Valley.
Walk-ins are welcome. Most tire jobs finish the same day.
Website: https://www.hankstire.com/
